title: 第9章 我是你们的后盾第10章 贵客上门
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
郁嘉庆夫妻回来后听到女儿说父亲又买了两辆车，原本还没觉得什么，听到车的品牌和型号自然又是一番惊叹。
吃晚饭时，郁凡才发现大孙子一直还没回来。
“郁景今天不回来吗？”郁凡奇怪的问。
“大哥每天都这样，昨天还是因为妈给他打电话才早点回来的。”郁景大口扒饭，倒是习以为常。
盛素华担心自家公公误会，连忙说道：“他们公司忙，郁景每天都要加班到比较迟才回来。”
郁颜对此颇有微词：“还不是他的那个上司，就是个更年期的老女人，看大哥长得俊俏，想要潜规则他。”
对于大哥的这份工作，郁颜早就有些想法了，一个快消品公司，在那里累死累活好几年，就因为不接受被潜，升职屡次被压制，拿着低微的提成吊着人，根本就是压榨人工。
“哇~大哥这样老实巴交的人居然会有人想要潜？”郁凌兴奋的瞪大了眼睛。
郁颜翻了翻白眼说：“大哥那张脸还是很能打的好吗？”正确说来，郁家的颜值都是很能抗的。
“明明可以靠脸吃饭，大哥居然还这么辛苦的想要靠能力，啧啧。”郁凌不由感叹。
郁颜似笑非笑：“让你去伺候一个快五十岁的老女人，就问你愿不愿吧？”
郁凌想到自己对着一张布满皱纹的脸撒娇的样子，不由一阵激灵，连连表示伺候不来，敬谢不敏！
盛素华知道自己儿子一直都很辛苦，但也没想到这其中还有这些事。她虽然只是一个家庭主妇，却得操持家里的生计，孩子们也不愿意将自己受得委屈告诉自己。
“那哥他为什么做了这么多年还不辞职？”郁凌不由奇怪的问。
郁嘉庆忍不住拍着自己的大腿说：“怪我，我之前跟他说过，在一个地方就要好好干下去，不要东想西想，最后可能会什么都得不到，谁知道，他还真的一直没跳过槽。”
他不由的有些责怪自己，大儿子一向内向老实，怎么就没有去多关注到他呢。
“应该也和我们家的条件有些关系吧，没有工作，负担更重。”郁颜小声吐槽，声音虽小到其他人并未听见，却进了郁凡的耳中。
想到自己的孩子们受到的委屈，郁凡不由皱眉。
“若是这份工作不是自己喜欢的，不去也罢。”郁凡对着郁嘉庆说道。
“给郁景打个电话，让他回来，现在的郁家已经不再是以前那个需要去为生活奔波的郁家了。”

郁凡郑重告诉所有人：“你们只需要去做自己想做的事情，你们的后盾就是我。”
郁嘉庆和郁颜不由一震，是啊，他们再也不是以前需要去忍受不平等待遇的郁家了，想到郁凡回来后，买房买车的举动，不仅仅只是生活便利，更多是给了他们可以面对他人的底气。
郁凌欲言又止，郁凡看了他一眼，“有话就说。”
“那我可以去做一个电竞选手吗？”
郁凡：“？？？”
郁凡示意郁嘉庆解释，郁颜看出爷爷的不解，抢先一步告状：“郁凌他就是不想读书了，想去打游戏！”
郁凡眉头一皱，虽然他支持孩子们做自己想做的事情，但是绝对不会允许家里有不学无术的子孙辈出现。
content_en:
After Yu Jiaqing and his wife came back, they heard their daughter say that her father had bought two more cars. They didn't think anything of it at first, but they were naturally surprised when they heard the make and model of the cars.
During dinner, Yu Fan discovered that his eldest grandson had not come back yet.
"Isn't Yu Jing coming back today?" Yu Fan asked strangely.
"Brother is like this every day. Yesterday, he came back early because his mother called him." Yu Jing gulped down his rice, but he was used to it.
Sheng Suhua was worried that her father-in-law would misunderstand, so she quickly said: "Their company is busy, and Yu Jing has to work overtime every day and doesn't come back until late."
Yu Yan was quite critical of this: "It's not his boss, she's just a menopausal old woman. Seeing how handsome the eldest brother is, she wants to hide her rules from him."
Yu Yan had already had some ideas about her elder brother's job. She had worked hard there for several years in a fast-moving consumer goods company. She was repeatedly suppressed for promotions because she refused to accept the offer. She was holding people back with a low commission, which was simply squeezing labor.
"Wow~ How can someone as honest and kind as Brother want to dive?" Yu Ling's eyes widened in excitement.
Yu Yan rolled her eyes and said, "Big brother's face is pretty good, okay?" To be precise, the Yu family's looks are pretty good.
"You can obviously rely on your face to make a living, but my eldest brother still works so hard to rely on his ability, tsk tsk." Yu Ling couldn't help but sigh.
Yu Yan smiled half-heartedly: "I asked you to serve an old woman who is almost fifty years old. Let me ask you if you are willing?"
Yu Ling couldn't help but feel excited when she thought of how she acted coquettishly in front of a wrinkled face, and repeatedly expressed that she couldn't serve her, thank you for your kindness!
Sheng Suhua knew that her son had been working hard, but he didn't expect that there were such things. Although she is just a housewife, she has to take care of the family's livelihood, and her children are not willing to tell her about the injustice they have suffered.
"Then why hasn't he resigned after working for so many years?" Yu Ling asked curiously.
Yu Jiaqing couldn't help but patted his thigh and said, "It's my fault. I told him before that you have to work hard in a place and don't think about it. You may get nothing in the end. Who knows, he really hasn't skipped the job."
He couldn't help but blame himself. His eldest son had always been introverted and honest, so why didn't he pay more attention to him.
"It probably has something to do with our family's conditions. Without a job, the burden is even heavier." Yu Yan complained in a low voice. Although the voice was so low that no one else heard it, it reached Yu Fan's ears.
Yu Fan couldn't help but frown when he thought of the injustice his children had suffered.
"If you don't like this job, just don't go." Yu Fan said to Yu Jiaqing.
"Call Yu Jing and ask him to come back. The Yu family now is no longer the Yu family that had to run for life."
Yu Fan solemnly told everyone: "You only need to do what you want to do, and I will be your backing."
Yu Jiaqing and Yu Yan were shocked. Yes, they were no longer the Yu family who had to endure unequal treatment before. Thinking that after Yu Fan came back, buying a house and a car not only made life more convenient, but also gave them the confidence to face others.
Yu Ling hesitated to speak. Yu Fan glanced at him and said, "If you have anything to say, just say it."
"Then can I become an e-sports player?"
Yu Fan: "???"
Yu Fan motioned to Yu Jiaqing to explain. Yu Yan saw his grandfather's confusion and complained first: "Yu Ling just doesn't want to study anymore and wants to play games!"
Yu Fan frowned. Although he supported the children in doing what they wanted to do, he would never allow unlearned children and grandchildren to appear in the family.
